body:
wake up folklore, in bed by midnight fully 1989 — tell me you don't have days like that 😭

this is the exact feeling we built Mood for. you tell it how you're feeling right now and it hands you back the Taylor era that matches the moment — not your favorite, not your 'main' era, just where your head is today. it is weirdly, specifically accurate and we cannot stop opening it.

so: which era are you in this very second? go tap Mood on longlivets.com, then tag the friend whose era is the complete opposite of yours — we want the chaos.

(pictured: Taylor in the 1989 set of the eras tour, inglewood 2023 — photo Paolo Villanueva, cc by 2.0, via wikimedia commons)
mediaCredit: Paolo Villanueva (CC BY 2.0), via Wikimedia Commons
altText: Taylor Swift in a sequined two-piece during the 1989 set of the Eras Tour, Inglewood 2023, shown close up on the stadium screen beside her on stage.

critique.rationale: IG sibling of the ask #4675 Mood re-draft — fan-gush mood-swing hook (folklore→1989), a plain description of what Mood does, and a tag-your-opposite share ask grounded in the post. Credited never-used 1989 Eras Tour Taylor photo; not fact-based by nature, so 'specific' rides the feature and era examples.

why: IG sibling of mood:era-match:redraft-4675 (ask #4675, 10-03 slot). Distinct opener/length from the X half; mandatory mood-item share hook (tag the friend whose era is the opposite). Mood has no deep link → 'tap Mood on longlivets.com'. Photo taylor-1989-inglewood-2023-2-ig191 (viewed, Taylor in frame), shared with X half per W8; photoEra unset (cross-era Mood post). Re-covers the founder-✅'d 09-23 Mood subject fresh; no invented mechanics.
failureReason: Still unposted more than 48h after founder approval — moved to social/failed/ regardless of current guard/preflight state (see social/README.md's 48h rule).
